files.policies.yml:
version: 1
base_currency: OMR
accounts: [salary, savings, broker, cash]
categories:
  income: [salary, bonus, side]
  expense: [housing, food, transport, family, discretionary, fees]
  transfer: [transfer]
  invest: [buy, sell, dividend]
snapshot_max_age_days: 45
policies:
  - id: CAP-HOLD
    type: cap
    title: food per month
    measure: {sum: expense.food, period: month}
    limit: {value: 100}
  - id: CAP-BREACH
    type: cap
    title: discretionary per month
    measure: {sum: expense.discretionary, period: month}
    limit: {pct_of: income, value: 1}
  - id: FLOOR-HOLD
    type: floor
    title: cash floor
    measure: {holdings: class.cash}
    limit: {value: 1000}
  - id: FLOOR-BREACH
    type: floor
    title: income per month
    measure: {sum: income, period: month}
    limit: {value: 2000}
  - id: ROUT-HOLD
    type: routine
    title: monthly transfer to savings
    match: {tags: transfer, account: savings, min_amount: 300}
    period: month
  - id: ROUT-MISS
    type: routine
    title: quarterly dividend booked
    match: {category: dividend}
    period: quarter
  - id: RED-HOLD
    type: red_line
    title: no margin, no options
    match: {tags_any: [margin, options]}
  - id: RED-BREACH
    type: red_line
    title: no single discretionary purchase above 200
    match: {category: discretionary, min_amount: 200}
  - id: KILL-HOLD
    type: kill
    title: broker drawdown, wide
    measure: {drawdown: account.broker, window_days: 90}
    limit: {pct: 50}
  - id: KILL-BREACH
    type: kill
    title: broker drawdown, tight
    measure: {drawdown: account.broker, window_days: 90}
    limit: {pct: 5}
  - id: ALLOC-HOLD
    type: allocation
    title: cash share
    measure: {share: class.cash}
    band: {min_pct: 50, max_pct: 100}
  - id: ALLOC-BREACH
    type: allocation
    title: equity share
    measure: {share: class.equity}
    band: {min_pct: 20, max_pct: 50}
